# Represent Commercial

> Principal-led buyer’s agency, commercial property management, leasing and tenant representation in Brisbane. Buyer’s agency across Brisbane, South East Queensland and regional Queensland. Office, retail and industrial. Typically working with commercial assets valued from $1 million to $10 million. Led by Nick O'Toole, Principal and Licensee, with 20+ years of owner-side commercial property experience. Real Estate Agent Licence 4949809.

## Brand
- Master brand: Exclusively on your side of the table.
- Supporting service descriptor: Property Management, Leasing, Buyer’s Agency & Tenant Representation.

## Services
1. Commercial Property Management — property management delivered with an asset-management mindset
2. Commercial Leasing — owner-side leasing of vacant commercial space
3. Buyer’s Agency & Acquisition Advisory — independent buyer representation, never acting for the vendor
4. Tenant Representation — tenant-side representation for occupiers
